properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Allowed CORS origins. Must be set explicitly — wildcards are not permitted.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: Allowed HTTP methods. Defaults to GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: Allowed request headers. Defaults to all headers (*).

properties.name: app.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Whether to include credentials (cookies, auth headers) in CORS requests.

properties.name: app.cors.max-age-seconds
properties.description: Preflight response cache TTL in seconds. Defaults to 1800 (30 minutes).

properties.name: app.jwt.private-key-path
properties.description: Path to the RSA private key PEM file used to sign JWTs.

properties.name: app.jwt.public-key-path
properties.description: Path to the RSA public key PEM file used to verify JWTs.

properties.name: app.jwt.access-token-ttl-seconds
properties.description: Access token TTL in seconds. Defaults to 900 (15 minutes).

properties.name: app.security.max-login-attempts
properties.description: Maximum consecutive login failures before the account is locked.

properties.name: app.security.lockout-duration-minutes
properties.description: Minutes an account remains locked after exceeding max-login-attempts.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum requests allowed per IP per minute.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.burst-capacity
properties.description: Token bucket burst capacity (must be ≤ requests-per-minute).
